name: ai.1court.state/court-directory
title: 1Court Directory
description: US county court directory: clerk, courthouse address, e-filing, filing fees, and case lookup.

tools.name: list_rule_sets
tools.description: List every deadline rule set 1Court covers, with rule counts and scope. Coverage: Deadlines: California in depth (civil, family, probate, eviction, small claims, government claims, criminal, juvenile, appeals, agencies, pre-suit clocks, special proceedings, statutes of limitations; local rules for all 58 counties), federal civil and criminal, federal bankruptcy, and a partial Texas set. Other states’ deadlines are not covered. Court directory: every U.S. county. Use the rule_set ids with search_rules, get_rule and calculate_deadline.

tools.name: search_rules
tools.description: Find deadline rules by plain words (for example "opposition to motion", "answer complaint", "notice of appeal"). Searches rule names, ids, citations and triggers. Optionally limit to one rule_set (TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL). Returns up to 20 rules with their rule_set, rule_id and rule page URL; use get_rule or calculate_deadline next.

query.description: Words describing the deadline, e.g. "opposition to motion" or "CCP 1005"

rule_set.description: Optional rule set id: TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: Get one deadline rule: its period, trigger, citation, the verbatim rule text, the official source URL, the 1Court rule page, any disclosed alternate reading (safe-date policy) and any fixed statutory dates. Show the user the citation and source link with every date or rule. Results are not legal advice.

rule_set.description: Rule set id: TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL

rule_id.description: Rule id from search_rules or list_deadline_rules

county.description: California county slug, to include that county’s local rules

court.description: Court id for local rules (cacd, cand, casd, caed, ca9, cacb, canb, casb, caeb, 1dca to 6dca)

tools.name: list_triggers
tools.description: List the trigger events ("what happened": summons served, motion hearing date, trial date, notice of entry of judgment served...) that a court's deadline rules run from, for one rule set (TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL). Each trigger shows how many deadlines it starts, whether the service method changes the dates, and, for broad triggers, the kinds you can narrow to (for a motion hearing: noticed motion, summary judgment...). Use with deadlines_from_trigger. Coverage: Deadlines: California in depth (civil, family, probate, eviction, small claims, government claims, criminal, juvenile, appeals, agencies, pre-suit clocks, special proceedings, statutes of limitations; local rules for all 58 counties), federal civil and criminal, federal bankruptcy, and a partial Texas set. Other states’ deadlines are not covered. Court directory: every U.S. county.

rule_set.description: Rule set id: TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL

county.description: California county slug for local rules, e.g. "los-angeles" (CA sets only)

court.description: Court id for local rules: cacd, cand, casd, caed, ca9, cacb, canb, casb, caeb, 1dca to 6dca

query.description: Optional words to filter triggers, e.g. "subpoena" or "served"

tools.name: deadlines_from_trigger
tools.description: Every deadline that follows one trigger event, like a docketing system: court, trigger, date in; all resulting deadlines out, each with its date, the rule citation, the official source and the 1Court rule page. Deadlines that apply only to some case types (limited civil, asbestos, PI Pathway...) are listed separately. For broad triggers (a motion hearing covers every motion type), pass kind to narrow (e.g. "Noticed motion", "Motion for summary judgment"); otherwise the usual kind is chosen and the rest are listed as other_deadlines. Ask the user for the trigger date and how the paper was served; do not assume them. Show the user the citation and source link with every date or rule. Results are not legal advice. Coverage: Deadlines: California in depth (civil, family, probate, eviction, small claims, government claims, criminal, juvenile, appeals, agencies, pre-suit clocks, special proceedings, statutes of limitations; local rules for all 58 counties), federal civil and criminal, federal bankruptcy, and a partial Texas set. Other states’ deadlines are not covered. Court directory: every U.S. county.

rule_set.description: Rule set id: TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL

date.description: Date of the trigger event, YYYY-MM-DD

county.description: California county slug for local rules, e.g. "los-angeles"

court.description: Court id for local rules (federal and appellate)

service_method.description: How the triggering paper (or the summons) was served, from the trigger's service_options. Omit for personal service.

kind.description: For broad triggers, the kind to select (from list_triggers kinds), or "all"

tools.name: list_deadline_rules
tools.description: List the deadline types 1Court can calculate for one rule set (TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL). Add county (California superior court, e.g. los-angeles) or court (cacd, cand, casd, caed, ca9 for US and US-CRIM; cacb, canb, casb, caeb for US-BK; 1dca to 6dca for CA-APP) to include local rules. Coverage: Deadlines: California in depth (civil, family, probate, eviction, small claims, government claims, criminal, juvenile, appeals, agencies, pre-suit clocks, special proceedings, statutes of limitations; local rules for all 58 counties), federal civil and criminal, federal bankruptcy, and a partial Texas set. Other states’ deadlines are not covered. Court directory: every U.S. county.

county.description: California county slug for local rules, e.g. "los-angeles", "san-diego" (CA sets only)

tools.name: calculate_deadline
tools.description: Calculate a court deadline from cited rules (weekends, court holidays, service extensions and local rules applied). Returns the date, each counting step, the verbatim rule text and source for every rule used, any safe-date disclosure and any fixed statutory dates. Ask the user for the trigger date and how the paper was served; do not assume them. Show the user the citation and source link with every date or rule. Results are not legal advice. Coverage: Deadlines: California in depth (civil, family, probate, eviction, small claims, government claims, criminal, juvenile, appeals, agencies, pre-suit clocks, special proceedings, statutes of limitations; local rules for all 58 counties), federal civil and criminal, federal bankruptcy, and a partial Texas set. Other states’ deadlines are not covered. Court directory: every U.S. county.

state.description: Rule set id: TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL

county.description: California county slug, to use that superior court's local rules and closures

court.description: Court id for local rules: cacd, cand, casd, caed, ca9, cacb, canb, casb, caeb, or 1dca to 6dca (CA-APP)

deadline_type.description: Rule id from search_rules or list_deadline_rules, e.g. "noticed_motion_opposition"

trigger_date.description: Trigger date as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. date of service or date judgment signed)

service_method.description: How the triggering paper was served, e.g. "mail" (TX), "mail_in_state", "electronic", "substituted" (CA). Omit for personal service.

tools.name: list_states
tools.description: List the U.S. states in the 1Court Directory, with how many counties each has. Use this to discover coverage before looking up a county.

tools.name: list_counties
tools.description: List the counties covered in a U.S. state (full name, 2-letter code or slug), each with its 1Court page URL.

state.description: State name, 2-letter code, or slug, e.g. "California", "CA", or "california"

tools.name: get_court_info
tools.description: Get verified court information for one U.S. county: clerk contacts, courthouse address, e-filing provider and whether it is mandatory, filing fees, case lookup, self-help, jury service and payment links, with the date it was last verified. civil_filing_fee is null when not yet verified (fee_status "unknown"), and some counties have no fixed fee (fee_status "clerk_sets_deposit"). Tell the user to confirm fees with the clerk before filing, and cite the 1Court page URL.

state.description: State name, 2-letter code, or slug, e.g. "Texas", "TX"

tools.name: search_courts
tools.description: Search the 1Court Directory by county or state name, courthouse name, city, or phone number. Returns matching counties and courthouses with their 1Court page URLs.

query.description: A county, state, courthouse name, city or phone number, e.g. "Maricopa", "Van Nuys courthouse", "Jersey City", "201-748-0156"
